## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: VXX (1W: +4.99% | 1M: -5.66%) ↑ rising | RECOVERY and HYG (1W: -0.71% | 1M: -0.34%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND with LQD (1W: -1.15% | 1M: -2.09%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND, plus weak sector breadth.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit stress rising: HYG/LQD ratio (Level: 0.7456 | 1W: +0.69% | 1M: +2.28%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND. Fear rising on a short-term basis: VXX (1W: +4.99% | 1M: -5.66%) ↑ rising | RECOVERY. Cyclical contraction vs defensives: Cyclical vs Defensive (1W: -5.99%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-tight: Dollar strength (Level: 28.5600 | 1W: +0.81% | 1M: +0.11%) → flat | ABOVE TREND while Yield Curve (Level: 1.0171 | 1W: -1.33% | 1M: -4.39%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND, pointing to tighter conditions.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy leading: XLE (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +9.03%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND; Industrials showing strength via sector breadth (1W: +2.55% | 1M: +4.10%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND. Tech lagging/momentum fading: XLK (1W: +0.52% | 1M: -3.12%) → flat | RECOVERY; Consumer Discretionary weak in breadth.

**5. US vs Global?**
US under short-term pressure: SPY (1W: -1.67% | 1M: +0.63%) ↓ falling | CORRECTION while EM/China show mixed recovery — EEM (1W: +0.64% | 1M: -3.83%) → flat | RECOVERY and FXI (1W: -0.20% | 1M: +4.96%) → flat | CORRECTION. IBIT (1W: +0.71% | 1M: +3.79%) → flat | ABOVE TREND contrasts with broader risk-off tone.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation cooling: Speculation Index (1W: -1.14% | 1M: -4.41%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND and ARKK (1W: -3.70% | 1M: -3.72%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND. Small cap pressure: IWM (1W: -1.18% | 1M: -1.09%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Commodity strength concentrated in energy and ags: BNO (1W: +14.26% | 1M: +25.65%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND and USO (1W: +16.92% | 1M: +25.37%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND; copper/industrial metals CPER (1W: +0.47% | 1M: +2.47%) → flat | ABOVE TREND. Gold as hedge: GLD (1W: +1.80% | 1M: -1.54%) ↑ rising | RECOVERY.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy clearly leading: XLE (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +9.03%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND with Brent BNO confirming. Natural gas mixed: UNG (1W: +1.82% | 1M: -7.74%) ↑ rising | RECOVERY but still weak on 1M.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Confirmed risk-off signals: VXX ↑ rising and HYG/LQD ↓ falling plus narrow breadth (3/11) — consistent confirmations. Major divergence present: SPY (1W: -1.67% | 1M: +0.63%) CORRECTION, XLK (1W: +0.52% | 1M: -3.12%) RECOVERY, XLF (1W: -1.62% | 1M: +3.62%) CORRECTION — this 1W vs 1M mismatch across core ETFs signals transition risk.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor defensive/commodity exposure: XLE (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +9.03%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND and defensive sectors (Utilities showing strength in breadth). Reduce exposure to momentum/growth risk: XLK (1W: +0.52% | 1M: -3.12%) → flat | RECOVERY and QQQ (1W: -1.98% | 1M: -3.04%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND, and monitor credit (HYG/LQD).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +9.03%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND and Industrials via breadth (1W: +2.55% | 1M: +4.10%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: QQQ (1W: -1.98% | 1M: -3.04%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND and Consumer Discretionary (breadth weak) likely vulnerable.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: BNO (1W: +14.26% | 1M: +25.65%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND and USO (1W: +16.92% | 1M: +25.37%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND. BEARISH/Watch: UNG (1W: +1.82% | 1M: -7.74%) ↑ rising | RECOVERY remains weak on 1M and needs monitoring.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~22 (VXX (1W: +4.99% | 1M: -5.66%) ↑ rising | RECOVERY) for rising volatility alert; HYG/LQD ~0.75 (Level: 0.7456 | 1W: +0.69% | 1M: +2.28%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND as a credit stress pivot; XLE strength confirmed while XLK/QQQ below 1M trend thresholds merits attention.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF with Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive, confirmed by rising VXX (1W: +4.99% | 1M: -5.66%) ↑ rising | RECOVERY and falling HYG/LQD (Level: 0.7456 | 1W: +0.69% | 1M: +2.28%) ↓ falling | ABOVE TREND. Energy and defensive-related exposures are showing strength, led by XLE (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +9.03%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND. Key risk is the 1W vs 1M divergence across core ETFs (SPY, XLK, XLF) — monitor credit and short-term volatility for confirmation.
